messages:
incident-bot: :pager: Paging @alice_oncall, @sre_jordan — high error-rate spike detected in prefix/KV cache layer affecting multiple tenants in us-west-2. Symptoms: 5xx errors + client-observed tokenization mismatches. Autosystem flagged 87% cache miss rate increase.

alice_oncall: I'm on it. can someone drop the initial failure logs here?

sre_jordan: pasting snippets, looks like cache write path is returning versions older than upstream storage for some prefixes, likely a race during snapshotting. see logs:
```
2026-03-15T18:05:12Z runtime: kv_cache: write_error tenant=acme prefix=org/acme/docs err=stale_write_detected
2026-03-15T18:05:13Z runtime: prefix_lookup: returned v=42 but store_v=43
```

runtime_ana: confirming, I'm seeing prefix-coherency checks failing during paging. hypothesis: a recent prefetch patch plus increased paging pressure caused concurrent stale reads. this can return incorrect completions for affected customers.

eng_ops_mike: customer-impact: CS reported multiple high-value customers (acme corp, studybuddy) seeing hallucination/corrupt outputs. Rachael, can you triage severity with CS?

cs_rachael: already pinged account teams. Acme says it's high-severity, they've paused calls in prod. issuing mitigation plan now.

alice_oncall: mitigation options: 1) disable prefix prefetching globally 2) force KV cache bypass for impacted tenant prefixes (slower but correct) 3) soft-rate-limit problematic tenants -> reduce p99 load 4) rollback prefetch patch to canary. prefer targeted first.

sre_jordan: agree with targeted route. propose: set per-tenant runtime override: `kv_cache.mode=BY_PASS` for prefixes matching `org/acme/*` and `org/studybuddy/*`. Also apply temporary per-tenant rps cap `20rps` to reduce racing.

runtime_ana: can do. preparing playbook, will patch runtime config now. deploy-bot: requesting safe toggle.

deploy-bot: queued config change. applying to us-west-2 control plane with gradual rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%)

eng_ops_mike: add a traffic-shaping rule in the edge to route heavy prefix reads to fallback read-path to avoid load on cache writer. sample rule:
```
route /v1/predict prefix org/acme/* -> fallback_read_path
rate_limit tenant=acme rps=20
```

alice_oncall: executing steps now. @runtime_ana please confirm when KV bypass is in place and monitor error rates.

runtime_ana: BYPASS applied to listed prefixes at 18:12 UTC, rollout 100% in region. watchlist: cache-miss -> expected + cost increase.

sre_jordan: observed errors drop from 14% -> 2% in 3m after bypass. latency p95 rose ~140ms, p99 up ~320ms. customers getting correct responses again.

cs_rachael: Acme confirmed mitigations: "we see correct outputs again, thanks" — asking for RCA and ETA for permanent fix.

product_liam: we should disable prefetch feature-flag for the next stable until we root cause. this will reduce perf for some tenants but avoid correctness regressions.

alice_oncall: agreed. plan: 1) keep KV bypass for affected tenants until patch 2) flip feature-flag `prefetch_v2` -> off globally 3) schedule hotfix for snapshot race in runtime repo.

runtime_ana: launching a quick rollback toggler for `prefetch_v2` now.

deploy-bot: feature-flag toggle completed at 18:20 UTC.

eng_ops_mike: quota change: lowering global burst quota for prefix-prefetch to avoid new hotspots. command run:
```
curl -X POST "https://ops-api/quotas" -d '{"scope":"prefetch","burst":50}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

sre_jordan: monitoring metrics: cache write error trend flattened, backend svc error budget stable. will keep KH alerts at higher sensitivity in case of regressions.

alice_oncall: customer impact summary for incident leading up to mitigations: ~6 tenants affected, highest-severity: acme (paused calls), avg incorrect-response window ~ 12m, mitigations restored correctness in ~8m after action. tagging incident as P1.

cs_rachael: filed customer support note and proactive outreach templates. will coordinate post-incident comms.

product_liam: owner for postmortem? @sre_jordan + @runtime_ana to co-own. include timelines, telemetry, and prompt test-suite to detect this class of bug.

sre_jordan: ack. will open postmortem ticket and assign follow-ups: snapshot-locking fix, prefetch rollback post-mortem, targeted tests.

alice_oncall: final action items: 1) keep tenant KV bypass until hotfix (owner: runtime_ana) 2) feature-flag off (done) 3) add regression evals to CI (owner: sre_jordan) 4) customer comms (owner: cs_rachael). I'll handoff to next on-call in 30m.

alice_oncall: handing off to @sre_jordan for overnight watch. :thumbsup:

sre_jordan: taking handoff. will point dashboards to incident runbook and keep 10m cadence checks for 2h.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=P1, impact=correctness for multiple tenants, mitigation=kv-bypass + prefetch FF off, owners=[sre_jordan,runtime_ana,cs_rachael].

alice_oncall: thanks team. closing thread for active paging; follow-ups in PM ticket.
